Plain text output format strips markdown syntax

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"output_format\":\"Plain\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h1>Title</h1><p>Some <strong>bold</strong> text.</p>", options)

}
```
